blocks.text: A new section opens with Khawaja Khijar-like martial challenge language around the hill campaign, as Banda tells Kahilur to gather what defense it can before five Singhs come against it.
The page names elephants, armed positions, and the practical setup of resistance, but the tone already assumes the coming assault will expose the weakness of that display.
It serves as the threshold to the next test, defining the encounter through the motif of five Singhs against concentrated worldly power.
